Munna

Psychic

Unova · Generation 5

Munna is a Psychic-type Dream Eater Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 0.6 m tall and weighs 23.3 kg. It evolves into Musharna. Its highest base stat is HP (76), with a base stat total of 292.
